name: ab_missing_causal_evidence_must_refuse
title: Missing causal evidence must refuse
text: An audit must distinguish an observed absence of violations from an absence of observations. Required evidence that is missing or incomplete produces refusal, never success.
trigger: Missing or truncated cluster history is treated as an empty history and produces a successful causal audit
check: Add destructive-history variants alongside code/tests/test_causal_adaptive_dynamics.py::test_causal_adaptive_simulation_prevents_acausal_merging. Delete cluster_history, truncate it, and remove a site from a partition; each variant must refuse rather than return a verified result.
